    Asian ground beef bowl with creamy cucumber salad

    1
    2
    3
    4
    5
    5
    1 Ratings
    Not enough ratings
    These Asian-inspired ground beef bowls are packed with bold flavor and ready in just 30 minutes. Savory beef with garlic, ginger, sesame, and crunchy cabbage is paired with a cool, creamy cucumber salad for the perfect contrast. An easy low-carb, high-protein dinner that’s great for busy weeknights and meal prep.

    Easy

    Asian ground beef bowl with creamy cucumber salad

    1
    2
    3
    4
    5
    5
    1 Ratings
    Not enough ratings
    These Asian-inspired ground beef bowls are packed with bold flavor and ready in just 30 minutes. Savory beef with garlic, ginger, sesame, and crunchy cabbage is paired with a cool, creamy cucumber salad for the perfect contrast. An easy low-carb, high-protein dinner that’s great for busy weeknights and meal prep.
    USMetric
    4 servingservings

    Ingredients

    Cucumber salad
    • 2 (11⁄3 lbs) 2 (600 g) cucumber
    • ½ cup 120 ml mayonnaise
    • 2 tbsp 2 tbsp rice vinegar or lime juice or lime juice
    • 2 tsp 2 tsp sesame oil
    • 2 2 garlic clove gratedgarlic cloves grated
    • 1 tsp 1 tsp chili flakes
    • 2 tsp 2 tsp lime juice
    • salt to taste
    Beef
    • 1¾ lbs 800 g ground beef or ground chicken
    • 7 oz. 200 g green cabbage finely shredded
    • 4 4 garlic clove mincedgarlic cloves minced
    • ¾ oz. (32⁄3 tbsp) 21 g (55 ml) fresh ginger grated
    • 3 tbsp 3 tbsp tamari soy sauce
    • 2 tsp 2 tsp sesame oil
    • 1 tsp 1 tsp chili flakes
    • 2 tsp 2 tsp rice vinegar or lime juice
    • 2 tsp 2 tsp sesame seeds
    • ½ cup (¼ oz.) 120 ml (8 g) fresh cilantro (optional)
    Nutrition
    High-protein low carb
    • Net carbs 10g 6%
    • Protein 43g 25%
    • Fat 52g 69%

    Fiber 3g

    Total Carbs 13g

    Satiety score 57

    See High protein guide

    Instructions

    Instructions are for 4 servings. Please modify as needed.

    1. Listen to audio version of this article
      Sponsored by
      0:00 / 2:36
      Instaread
      Thinly slice the cucumbers. Whisk the mayonnaise, rice vinegar, sesame oil, grated garlic, chili flakes, and lime juice. Season with salt, toss with the cucumber, and chill while you cook the beef.
    2. Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks, until no longer pink.
    3. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook about 1 minute, until fragrant.
    4. Stir in the soy sauce or tamari, sesame oil, chili flakes, and rice vinegar. Cook 1–2 minutes.
    5. Add the shredded cabbage and cook 1–2 minutes, until just wilted but still crisp.
    6. Divide the beef between bowls. Top with the creamy cucumber salad, fresh cilantro, sesame seeds, and extra chili flakes if you like.

    How to meal prep Asian ground beef bowls

    The ground beef mixture keeps well in the fridge for 3–4 days, making this recipe great for meal prep. Store the creamy cucumber salad separately and add it just before serving to keep the cucumber fresh and crisp.

    How to keep it gluten-free

    Use gluten-free tamari instead of regular soy sauce. Always check the label, as some soy sauces contain wheat.

    Adjust the spice level

    For a milder Asian ground beef bowl, reduce or omit the chili flakes. If you like more heat, add extra chili flakes or sliced fresh chili when serving.

    Keep the cabbage crisp

    Cook the shredded cabbage for just 1–2 minutes. It should soften slightly while still keeping some crunch, which adds texture to the beef bowl.

    Low-carb serving ideas

    Serve as is for an easy low-carb meal, or add extra shredded cabbage, cauliflower rice, or leafy greens for a larger serving.
